acceptanceCriteria: The test passes 20 of 20 under -race with GOMAXPROCS=2 and a CPU-saturating background load.
The fix removes the timing dependence (readiness handshake or injected clock) rather than raising a timeout.
body: Observed 2026-10-19 in the V1-1919/1930-1932 lane (PR #1201, head 8f45fff96): `go test -race ./internal/jstestprovider` at load average ~38 failed TestPWPV0030ExternalTimeoutInterruptsRunnerFirst with "runner did not see SIGINT"; it passed 3 of 3 run alone. Expected: the test is deterministic under load (no wall-clock race between the timeout and the runner's signal handler). Related, distinct: V1-1812 (SIGINT-on-timeout reported as cancelled).
title: jstestprovider TestPWPV0030ExternalTimeoutInterruptsRunnerFirst flakes under -race at high host load
